code2='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # The two long, matching bars lie on opposite borders.
    bars = []
    if all(v == bg for v in grid[0]) is False and all(v == bg for v in grid[-1]) is False:
        top = [c for c,v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v != bg]
        bot = [c for c,v in enumerate(grid[-1]) if v != bg]
        if top and bot:
            bars = [('h',0,grid[0][top[0]],top), ('h',h-1,grid[-1][bot[0]],bot)]
    if not bars and all(grid[r][0] == bg for r in range(h)) is False and all(grid[r][-1] == bg for r in range(h)) is False:
        left = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != bg]
        right = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][-1] != bg]
        if left and right:
            bars = [('v',0,grid[left[0]][0],left), ('v',w-1,grid[right[0]][-1],right)]
    if len(bars) != 2:
        return out
    bar_color = bars[0][2]
    marks = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != bar_color]
    if not marks:
        return out
    fill = grid[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]
    # Marker positions select offsets along each bar; copy those lanes to the opposite bar.
    vertical_bars = bars[0][0] == 'v'
    origin = min(bars[0][3][0], bars[1][3][0]) if vertical_bars else min(bars[0][3][0], bars[1][3][0])
    offsets = sorted({(r if vertical_bars else c) - origin for r,c in marks})
    for r,c in marks:
        out[r][c] = 4
    for kind, edge, color, indices in bars:
        start = min(indices)
        lanes = [start+off for off in offsets if start+off <= max(indices)]
        if kind == 'h':
            direction = 1 if edge == 0 else -1
            for c in lanes:
                r = edge + direction
                while 0 <= r < h:
                    if grid[r][c] == fill:
                        out[r][c] = 4
                        break
                    if grid[r][c] != bg:
                        break
                    out[r][c] = fill
                    r += direction
        else:
            direction = 1 if edge == 0 else -1
            for r in lanes:
                c = edge + direction
                while 0 <= c < w:
                    if grid[r][c] == fill:
                        out[r][c] = 4
                        break
                    if grid[r][c] != bg:
                        break
                    out[r][c] = fill
                    c += direction
    return out
'''
